sections.title: Desk page styles
sections.what: Holds all Desk styles in one block: item cards, headers, swing numbers, stories, the pending box, the depth switch and the reading text.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the Desk look in one file.

summary: Styles for the Desk page: item cards, swing numbers, the depth switch and the reading text.
purpose: Makes the Desk page readable and consistent.
why: Likely reason: Desk-specific looks are kept together in one file.
how: Sets spacing and grids for lists and cards, font sizes for names and values, a wrapping layout for the depth switch, a visible focus ring for keyboard users, and a reading font for the text.
inputs: Class names from the Desk page and the depth switch, and theme variables defined elsewhere.
outputs: The visual layout of the Desk page only.
risks: Relies on variables such as the line and focus colours defined elsewhere. If a variable is missing, that colour does not apply.
debug: If a style looks missing, check that class names match the components and that the variables exist in the shared tokens.
